# nanoflags_environment_publish (Resource)

Publishes an environment's draft as its next revision, under the same rules as the dashboard: environments that require approvals or scenario checks refuse a publish that does not meet them (pass the reviewed `change`). Distribution to SDKs starts immediately.

A publish happens on create, whenever `triggers` change, and whenever the plan finds unpublished draft changes. Put the configuration you publish in `triggers` (see the example) so edits made in the same apply are published by it. Destroying this resource does not unpublish anything.

Scope: `publish` (and `flags:read`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Publishes the development draft whenever the configuration managed here changes.
resource "nanoflags_environment_publish" "development" {
  project     = "web"
  environment = "development"
  note        = "Published by Terraform"

  triggers = {
    flags = sha1(jsonencode([
      nanoflags_flag_environment.new_checkout_development,
      nanoflags_segment.pro_customers,
    ]))
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment` (String) Environment key or id.
- `project` (String) Project key or id.

### Optional

- `change` (String) Id of the reviewed change to publish. Required in environments that only accept reviewed changes.
- `note` (String) Publish note shown in the revision history (at most 500 characters).
- `triggers` (Map of String) Arbitrary values; any change publishes again. Typically `sha1(jsonencode(...))` of the flag configurations of this environment.

### Read-Only

- `checksum` (String) Checksum of the published revision.
- `id` (String) `<project>/<environment>`.
- `revision` (Number) The environment's published revision.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <project key>/<environment key>
terraform import nanoflags_environment_publish.development web/development
```
